name: @qubeio/lm-tasker-mcp

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Get all tasks from LM-Tasker, optionally filtering by status and including subtasks.

withSubtasks.description: Include subtasks nested within their parent tasks in the response

file.description: Path to the tasks file (relative to project root or absolute)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific task

file.description: Path to the tasks file relative to project root

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the project root directory (Optional, usually from session)

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: Find the next task to work on based on dependencies and status

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: set_task_status
tools.description: Set the status of one or more tasks or subtasks.

id.description: Task ID or subtask ID (e.g., '15', '15.2'). Can be comma-separated to update multiple tasks/subtasks at once.

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generates individual task files in tasks/ directory based on tasks.json

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

output.description: Output directory (default: same directory as tasks file)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a new task manually with specified details. Automatically initializes the project (creates tasks.json and project structure) if this is the first task.

dependencies.description: Comma-separated list of task IDs this task depends on

file.description: Path to the tasks file (default: tasks/tasks.json)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: add_subtask
tools.description: Add a subtask to an existing task

taskId.description: Existing task ID to convert to subtask

title.description: Title for the new subtask (when creating a new subtask)

details.description: Implementation details for the new subtask

dependencies.description: Comma-separated list of dependency IDs for the new subtask

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file (default: tasks/tasks.json)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Update multiple upcoming tasks (with ID >= 'from' ID) - FUNCTIONALITY REMOVED. Use other task management commands instead.

from.description: Task ID from which to start updating (inclusive). IMPORTANT: This tool uses 'from', not 'id'

file.description: Path to the tasks file relative to project root

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. (Optional, usually from session)

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Updates a single task by ID by appending timestamped details.

id.description: ID of the task (e.g., '15') to update. Must be a positive integer.

details.description: Additional details or information to append to the task. Will be timestamped and added to existing details.

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: update_subtask
tools.description: Appends timestamped information to a specific subtask without replacing existing content

id.description: ID of the subtask to update in format "parentId.subtaskId" (e.g., "5.2"). Parent ID is the ID of the task that contains the subtask.

details.description: Additional details or information to append to the subtask. Will be timestamped and added to existing details.

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: remove_task
tools.description: Remove a task or subtask permanently from the tasks list

id.description: ID of the task or subtask to remove (e.g., '5' or '5.2'). Can be comma-separated to update multiple tasks/subtasks at once.

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

confirm.description: Whether to skip confirmation prompt (default: false)

tools.name: remove_subtask
tools.description: Remove a subtask from its parent task

id.description: Subtask ID to remove in format 'parentId.subtaskId' (required)

convert.description: Convert the subtask to a standalone task instead of deleting it

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file (default: tasks/tasks.json)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

id.description: Task IDs (comma-separated) to clear subtasks from

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file (default: tasks/tasks.json)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: move_task
tools.description: Move a task or subtask to a new position

from.description: ID of the task/subtask to move (e.g., "5" or "5.2"). Can be comma-separated to move multiple tasks (e.g., "5,6,7")

to.description: ID of the destination (e.g., "7" or "7.3"). Must match the number of source IDs if comma-separated

projectRoot.description: Root directory of the project (typically derived from session)

tools.name: add_dependency
tools.description: Add a dependency relationship between two tasks

id.description: ID of task that will depend on another task

dependsOn.description: ID of task that will become a dependency

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file (default: tasks/tasks.json)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: remove_dependency
tools.description: Remove a dependency from a task

id.description: Task ID to remove dependency from

dependsOn.description: Task ID to remove as a dependency

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file (default: tasks/tasks.json)

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: validate_dependencies
tools.description: Check tasks for dependency issues (like circular references or links to non-existent tasks) without making changes.

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.

tools.name: fix_dependencies
tools.description: Fix invalid dependencies in tasks automatically

file.description: Absolute path to the tasks file

projectRoot.description: The directory of the project. Must be an absolute path.
